study hacks i wish
i knew earlier pt. 2

write your notes as questions, not sentences.
"what caused the war?" instead of "the war was caused by...". later you cover the answers and quiz yourself.

don't just learn the answer, ask WHY it's true.
if you can explain why, you'll remember it way longer than the answer alone.

connect every definition to something from your own life.
your brain holds on to what feels personal.

turn your phone screen grey while you study.
no colors = way less tempting to open it and scroll.

draw it. a quick sketch of a process, a cell or a map
sticks better than reading the same paragraph again.

read your essay out loud before you hand it in.
your ears catch the mistakes your eyes skip.
try these now and thank me later
